paragraphs: Rav Pinhas and Rav Mari, sons of Rav Hisda: pious priests with whom Elijah spoke [the cited Bavli says he spoke only with the one who served first] (see there for his other brothers), Ketubbot 61a:15. In Kiddushin 32b:2, they did not rise before Rava, and he took offense at them. Rav Mari was his son [referent unresolved].
